isolation.description: Pure Rust workspace, no running services, clean committed tree

steps.action: Search for hardcoded dimension literals in widget new()/at_cursor() methods in katla_ui/src/widgets/
steps.expected: All Vec2::new() calls in new() and at_cursor() reference Style/DEFAULTS fields, not bare numeric literals
steps.observed: All 11 widget types (Button, ImageButton, Checkbox, ToggleButton, Slider, TextInput, Label, Badge, RadioButton, ProgressBar, Collapsible) use DEFAULTS.* or ui.style.* fields for dimensions. No bare numeric dimension literals found in new() or at_cursor() methods.

steps.action: Verify Style struct has fields for widget defaults
steps.expected: Style struct has fields like button_default_width, icon_button_size, etc.
steps.observed: Style struct has 16 dimension fields: button_default_width, button_default_height, icon_button_size, checkbox_default_width, checkbox_default_height, slider_default_width, slider_default_height, text_input_default_width, text_input_default_height, label_default_width, label_default_height, radio_button_default_width, radio_button_default_height, progress_bar_default_width, progress_bar_default_height, collapsible_default_width, collapsible_default_height, badge_default_width, badge_default_height. WidgetDefaults const DEFAULTS also exists with matching fields.

steps.action: Verify new() and at_cursor() methods read dimensions from style
steps.expected: new() uses DEFAULTS.*, at_cursor() uses ui.style.*
steps.observed: Confirmed: new() uses DEFAULTS.button_default_width etc. at_cursor() uses ui.style.button_default_width etc. Label::at_cursor() uses ui.measure_text() for text-based sizing. Badge::at_cursor() uses ui.measure_text() with padding.

evidence.styleFields: 16 dimension fields in Style struct + WidgetDefaults const DEFAULTS
evidence.widgetsChecked: Button, ImageButton, Checkbox, ToggleButton, Slider, TextInput, Label, Badge, RadioButton, ProgressBar, Collapsible (11 total)

assertions.title: Hierarchy view uses reusable ListView widget

steps.action: Search for struct ListView in katla_ui/
steps.observed: pub struct ListView<'a, F> found at katla_ui/src/widgets/list_view.rs:28. Implements Widget trait with virtualized rendering (only renders visible rows).

steps.action: Search for ListView usage in katla_app/src/ui/editor_ui/hierarchy.rs
steps.observed: Line 5: 'use katla_ui::widgets::ListView;' imported. Line 130: 'ListView::new("hierarchy_scroll", &mut self.state.scroll_state).bounds(content_bounds).item_count(visible_entities.len()).row_height(22.0).render_each(|ui, index, row_bounds| { ... })'

steps.action: Search for manual cursor advancement patterns in hierarchy.rs
steps.observed: Zero matches for advance_cursor, advance_vertical, cursor.y, or cursor.x in hierarchy.rs. The ListView handles all scrolling internally.

summary: Tested 2 assertions: 2 passed. VAL-POLISH-003: All 11 widget types use Style/DEFAULTS fields for dimensions in new()/at_cursor(), zero hardcoded literals.
